notes: All four shots are real renders of the game's own code (game/src/shots.js stageShot), taken headless with tools/capture.mjs. No editing, no compositing. HUD shows cash, health, wanted stars + heat bar, mission banner, hurricane countdown, minimap and message feed in every shot.
